answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one ridge weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 239 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 278 times the capital for one share. The lotus report makes public the merge explicitly at each dune. A farm of 1899 identities would post 3731 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
